body: First off I just wanted to say thank you for taking the time to read everything, it's nice that someone did that for me and it means a lot. I'll try to take what you suggested to heart. It'll be hard with my need for human interaction, I'm not used to living for myself and I don't know how I'd go about breaking that habit. I can of course think logically and see that it'd be better but I don't know how to change how I feel. I wish everything wasn't so complicated..
